Things to know before you arrive:

Important Information

  • Last entry is two (2) hours before the venue closes. For current operating hours, visit our Plan Your Visit page at https://www.universalhorrorunleashed.com/en/us/plan-your-visit.
  • Universal Horror Unleashed is located at AREA15, about 10 minutes from The Strip and Downtown Las Vegas.
  • Rideshare is strongly encouraged as parking is limited.
  • When planning your arrival, please allow time for parking, security, and accessing the venue.
  • Ticket is valid on your selected date and time only.
  • Universal Horror Unleashed is located at AREA15, which restricts access to minors certain times of the week and has a chaperone policy. See AREA15 FAQs for details about when age restrictions apply. 
  • No outside food or beverages allowed.
  • This ticket may not be altered, copied, transferred, or resold. This ticket is only valid for the person named on it, or when accompanied by the person named on it. Valid photo ID required.
 

Cancellation Policy

  • Ticket is non-transferable, non-refundable, and non-exchangeable.
 

Prohibited Items

  • Professional-grade cameras and recording equipment, unless authorized media credentials are held.
    • This includes professional-grade cameras with detachable lenses, tripods, monopods and audio/video recording devices.
    • Please reach out to UHUMedia@UDX.com to submit a media visit request.
  • Selfie-sticks
  • Find the full list of Prohibited Items here.

†General Admission Ticket (One-Time Access) - Nevada Resident
Ticket is valid on your selected date. Last entry is two (2) hours prior to scheduled closing time. Ticket entitles a Nevada resident to one (1) General Admission to the Universal Horror Unleashed common areas and same-day, one-time General Admission to each haunted house, and subject to the venue’s operating hours and availability. Credit card with Nevada billing zip code required for purchase. Adults aged eighteen (18) and over may be asked to present proof of residency at the Universal Horror Unleashed venue for admission (such as Nevada issued driver’s license or identification, military identification, utility bills, voter registration card, student ID, etc.). Arrival without qualifying proof of residency may result in an additional charge (i.e., the difference between your actual purchase price and the General Admission Ticket (One-Time Access) price available at the Universal Horror Unleashed venue on your date of visit). Universal Horror Unleashed is located at AREA15, which restricts access to minors certain times of the week and has a chaperone policy. See https://area15.com/faqs/ for details before your purchase and visit. Experience may be too intense for young children and is not recommended for children under the age of 13. Costumes subject to costume policy. No costume masks allowed. Re-entry not permitted. No outside food or beverages allowed. Parking not included. Venue operates rain or shine. No rain checks or returns. Ticket is non-transferable, non-refundable and non-exchangeable. This ticket may not be altered, copied, transferred or resold. This ticket is only valid for the person named on it, or when accompanied by the person named on it. Valid photo ID required. Ticket cannot be combined with other offers, separately ticketed events, or discounts. Universal reserves the right to revoke the license granted by this ticket.
